title: Paloma and the Asset
author: O. M. Reyes
blurb: Emrys Iversen, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
